blocks.text: Wings are muscle, and muscle tires. Stamina is the breath of your wings, and its size is your Endurance: 50 at the lowest, 300 at the highest.

Each wing jump costs 20. Beating your wings in travel flight costs about 10 per second, the same for every pair: slow wings pay more per beat, fast ones less. Entering travel flight or taking off costs one beat. Hovering drains 2.5 per second.
Gliding, diving and braking cost nothing.
On the ground you recover 20 stamina per second. While gliding in travel flight, without beating or braking, you recover 3 per second.
In travel flight, your wings stay open but cannot beat. You can still glide, steer and brake down to the ground; braking with no stamina lets you sink at 3 m/s. You cannot switch modes.
While hovering, you fall: nothing holds you up.

When stamina falls below the cost of a wing jump, two free rescue jumps remain. Each one stops your fall and erases the fall damage you had gathered. They return only on the ground. The first usually goes by reflex; keep the second for when it counts.

blocks.caption: Flasks and tanks of Intensified Cloud Essence

blocks.text: Carry a flask or a tank of Intensified Cloud Essence and it steps in when your stamina runs dry: one unit of essence for one point of stamina. Flasks are emptied first, then tanks. It does nothing in creative, or for an owner of the Night Wings, whose stamina never ends.

A thin vertical bar beside the right end of your hotbar shows your stamina; it turns red below a quarter. Small gold marks above it count your rescue jumps. The bar hides itself when it is full and you are not flying. The charge of a take-off fills a small bar under your crosshair.
The Night Wings: stamina without end
